notes.title: SPOOKWARE v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hey there folks!

There's been a lot going on behind the hive at ol' Beeswax Games, and we're excited to put out a fraction of what we've been working on today! This is a significant update to the gamepad input system in SPOOKWARE, with the primary goal of making the experience as enjoyable as it is on M/KB! And accompanying these changes are minor bug fixes across the chapters! 
[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes
Miscellaneous:

 Added controller glyphs for microgames that use the W,A,S,D function. When the game detects that a gamepad is being used, these glyphs will take the place of the arrow keys, and vice-versa with KB/M.
 Certain text and terminology in Chapter 2 has been changed to reflect the changes made with controllers in mind
 The following microgames in Chapter 2 have had their sensitivity adjusted for controller:
    Chalk: .4 -> .3
    Differences: 1 -> .65
    Heart: 1 -> .75
    Equation: 1 -> .7
    Inspect: 1 -> .75
    Lock: 1 -> .8
    Puzzle: 1 -> .8
    Skeleton Boss: 1 -> .25

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where settings menu on Title Screen would also control Title's screen menu.
 Fixed bug where music had a chance to cut off during gameplay.
 Fixed error message Chapter 2's dream Sequence.
 LEFTI name no longer pops up twice in lady red dialogue.
 D-pad no longer gets cut off in Chapter 3 microgame screen (changed value from 590 to 635).
 Fixed error during Chapter 3's ending cinematic.
 Fixed error blocking progress in Chapter 3's final restaurant sequence.
 And other minor fixes across the three changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/3befcd1c349d24e968b654329500992142b3ab8f.png

notes.title: V1.1 - Chapter 1 Improvements, Visual upgrade & More!
notes.content:
SPOOKWARE V1.1 is NOW live on Steam! 
We've read your reviews and listened to your feedback!

ːleftiː Chapter 1 Improvements
We've taken the time to spice Chapter 1 up in a big way!
Update 1.1 brings brand new microgames to chapter 1, some of them tying into the story while others are placed in completely arbitrary locations just because we thought it'd be fun to have them there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750096/ab150b23fd6fe98e8688ecb4ae3b800577e24be6.gif

We hope you have fun playing them all!
If you're interested in which microgames we added, here's an overview:
[spoiler]Try and stay awake in Classroom 1A[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Raise the teacher's desk in Classroom 1B[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Score a BONE run at the baseball field[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Paint your favorite bones in the Art classroom[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Find the weak student and grab some milk for them[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Clear the way in the Library by pushing a trolley[/spoiler]

ːmidiː Painterly Filter
Additionally, we're also upgrading the look of SPOOKWARE!
Now the game has a more painted feel to it, blending the hand-drawn characters and the environment together. And well, now we've done that!
Enjoy a smoother SPOOKWARE than ever before with this new visual update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750096/bd3f984e15b4863dc3e114da6a0fa7b4ed92b220.png

Hey Psst, Don't worry if this isn't your style. You can always turn it off in the settings!

ːrightiː Community Items
Steam has noticed us and has given us the chance to make community items for SPOOKWARE!
We now have Trading cards, emotes, profile backgrounds, and badges! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750096/ba5caf7c5f4e1f2ba35a980ade652a0bf0dbade0.gif


ːmetalsteedː Additional Changes:

 Removed text prompts for warping in numerous locations where they felt unnecessary (f.ex. leaving rooms, entering obvious areas)
 Shortened some dialogue in Chapter 1 that felt too long. 
 Updated layout of the Library in Chapter 1 to fit with new microgame.

notes.title: Update Notes V1.04
notes.content:
CHANGES:

 Added AZERTY Support
 Added a pop-up after every major tape sequence that tells the player that they've unlocked new tapes in the basement. 
 Players can now immediately replay the prologue microgames by interacting with the tv in the basement.
 Virtuoso achievement, found in Chapter 1, pop-up now happens whenever you perfect a recruit microgame, not just the first one.
 Added music notes coming out of the band room in the gym to more easily guide the player to the band room.
 Added additional signs to the cruise ship to guide the player where to go.


BUGS:

 Fixed bug where the game would freeze when quitting out of the game in the remix mode and starting it back up again.
 Sound can no longer be heard in the tape collection when setting the master volume to 0.
 When starting a new game, the Sound and graphics settings are no longer reset to 100.
 In the tape collection, the boss recipe microgame is now correctly stated to have mouse controls.
 After using the kill screen in an old sequence, it will no longer appear immediately when starting a new sequence and losing once.
 The ghost flashing microgame found in Ch1 will no longer say Too Soon / Too late at the wrong times.
 Fixed a bug where it was possible for players to fall out of the map in the Sewers.
 Fixed a bug where pausing in the full credits sequence wouldn't stop the sequence from moving.


We hope you're all having a lot of fun with the game! 
Thank you for all the feedback so far!

notes.title: Update Notes V1.03
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where player unlocking Chapter 2 didn't register if they closed the game after, causing them to have to play the final sequence of Chapter 1 again. If you unlocked CH2 before, it should be on your map screen again now!
 Fixed a bug where the Perfect achievement for CH3 would be given out even when lives are lost.
 Fixed a bug where the Bone-licious achievement for completing CH3 had a chance of not begin given out to the player. If this happened to you, just go to the map screen and you should receive it!

notes.title: Update Notes V1.02
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the initial alarm microgame had a chance to not be in the tape collection.
 - Fixed a bug where the ribcage microgame's sound in chapter 1 would play twice.
 - Fixed a bug that didn't allow players to receive a hidden achievement related to tree guys... If this happened to you, just look for the tree guy in the third chapter again!
 - Fixed a bug where players would get locked out of later completed chapters after completing earlier ones again! (sorry 100%'ers). Anyone who had this happen to them should have their old chapters unlocked again!
 - Fixed a bug where players could get trapped at the far side of MrBlue's bed.

notes.title: Update Notes V1.01_3
notes.content: Fixed potential bug where the Map Screen would be broken after completing Chapter 3.
